01How it teaches

Built from how people learn

Short lessons you control

Each lesson is a few minutes of slides. You move at your own pace, go back, and stop when you like.

See it done, then do it

Every part starts from a finished example, then asks you to try. The support fades as you go, as in the live day.

Pause and recall

Each lesson ends by asking what you remember before it shows you. Reviews return at 1, 3, 7 and 21 days. Your progress is stored in this browser only.

Read, listen, or both

Every slide has a transcript. A read-aloud voice is built in, and lessons with recorded narration play it.

Retrieval practice and spacing are well studied, but the size of the effect varies. A 2024 study across nine STEM courses found a small average gain from spaced retrieval (about two percentage points) and not in every course (Bego and colleagues, International Journal of STEM Education). We use both because they cost you little, not because they guarantee a result.

    06Questions

    Before you decide

    Is this the same as the live workshop?

    The material is the same. The live day adds feedback on your own system, work with other people, and a chance to ask questions as they come up.

    How do I get access?

    Message sales on WhatsApp. We reply with how to pay, and send your access code when payment is confirmed.

    Can I share my code?

    Please do not. The code is personal and your name appears on every lesson.

    What if I lose my code or change device?

    Ask again and we will send it again.

    What about refunds?

    Refund terms are confirmed in writing when you enquire, before you pay.
